name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 45 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
